snippet.title: Servant of the Lake - Official Narrative Trailer
snippet.description:
Servant of the Lake launches in August 2026. 

In the meantime, please enjoy our latest Official Narrative Trailer as we inaugurate the celebrations for our 11th anniversary of Rusty Lake! 
Pre-order Servant of the Lake on mobile, wishlist the game on Steam, and follow us on itch.io! 👇

🍎 App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/6748751735
🤖Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.RustyLake.ServantOfTheLake
 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/ 
🦐 itchio: https://rustylake.itch.io/servant-of-the-lake

The Servant of the Lake Lite is now available on mobile on both iOS and Android:

🍎 App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762027410 
🤖 Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.RustyLake.ServantOfTheLakeLite 

And you can still play the latest demo version on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3996940/Servant_of_the_Lake_Demo/

Be sure to thank your new employers by leaving us a rating/review after playing Servant of the Lake lite!

Special thanks to:

🎞️ Bob Rafferty for yet another amazing trailer
🎵 Victor Butzelaar for composing the perfect soundtrack
🔔 Driftwood audio for the atmospheric sound effects
